landing.headline: Making everyday studying at {orgAlias} more convenient
landing.lead: One platform of the Academic Lyceum {orgName} for students, teachers, staff and applicants.
landing.ctaApply: Want to apply to {orgAlias}? Ask the {appMy} AI to learn more!
landing.ctaApplyHint: Opens the Telegram bot in guest mode
landing.ctaStudent: Already a student? It's your personal helper: new marks notifications, timetable, homework, AI study notebooks…

why.title: Why {appMy}?
why.lead: Everything you need for a school day in one place, on the phone and in Telegram.

marks.title: Marks, ПК and ИК
marks.text: A notification as soon as a new mark, Промежуточный контроль or Итоговый контроль result appears.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.text: Today's lessons, rooms and changes at a glance, Monday to Friday.

homework.title: Homework
homework.text: Tasks from every subject with deadlines, so nothing is forgotten.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.text: Your absences and work-offs, clear and up to date.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.text: Ask about any topic and get an explanation that fits your lessons.

notebooks.title: Notebooks and Studio
notebooks.text: AI study notebooks from your materials: summaries, quizzes and more.

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.text: Make card sets and repeat them right before the test.

mail.title: Mail
mail.text: A student mailbox for messages from the lyceum.

library.title: Library
library.text: Find and read books from the lyceum library online.

bot.title: Telegram bot
bot.text: Marks, timetable and the assistant right inside Telegram.

platforms.title: One platform, several apps
platforms.lead: Real screens of the apps on a phone.
